blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createWorkflow` . It belongs to the Workflows SDK.

This function creates a workflow with the provided name and a constructor function.
The constructor function builds the workflow from steps created by the [createStep](/references/workflows/createStep) function.
The returned workflow is an exported workflow of type [ReturnWorkflow](/references/workflows/types/workflows.ReturnWorkflow), meaning it's not executed right away. To execute it,
invoke the exported workflow, then run its `run` method.

types.name: TData
types.description: The type of the input passed to the composer function.

types.name: TResult
types.description: The type of the output returned by the composer function.

types.name: THooks
types.description: The type of hooks defined in the workflow.

types.name: nameOrConfig
types.description: The name of the workflow or its configuration.

children.name: timeout
children.description: The global timeout for the entire transaction workflow (in seconds).

children.name: store
children.description:
If true, the state of the transaction will be persisted.

Learn more in [this documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/store-executions).

children.name: retentionTime
children.description:
The number of seconds that the workflow execution should be stored in the database.

Learn more in [this documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/store-executions).

children.name: storeExecution
children.description: If true, the execution details of each step will be stored.

children.name: idempotent
children.description: If true, the workflow will use the transaction ID as the key to ensure only-once execution

children.name: schedule
children.description:
Defines the workflow as a scheduled workflow that executes based on the cron configuration passed.
The value can either by a cron expression string, or an object that also allows to define the concurrency behavior.

children.name: concurrency
children.description:
Setting whether to allow concurrent executions (eg. if the previous execution is still running, should the new one be allowed to run or not)
By default concurrent executions are not allowed.

children.name: numberOfExecutions
children.description: Optionally limit the number of executions for the scheduled workflow. If not set, the workflow will run indefinitely.

types.name: composer
types.description:
The constructor function that is executed when the `run` method in [ReturnWorkflow](/references/workflows/types/workflows.ReturnWorkflow) is used.
The function can't be an arrow function or an asynchronus function. It also can't directly manipulate data.
You'll have to use the [transform](/references/workflows/transform) function if you need to directly manipulate data.

types.name: ReturnWorkflow
types.description: The created workflow. You can later execute the workflow by invoking it, then using its `run` method.
